summary: Guardforce AI Co., Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its adjourned extraordinary general meeting held November 3, 2026 (adjourned from October 27) in Hong Kong, with 10,348,625 ordinary shares (about 32.38% of 31,958,004 outstanding as of the September 28 record date) present to form a quorum. Shareholders approved all three proposals, including a special-resolution capital reorganization combining a 40-for-1 share consolidation (par US$0.12 to US$4.80), capital reduction to US$0.001, and subdivision into 36,000,000,000 new shares, plus re-designation of share capital and a new memorandum and articles. This is a routine meeting-result filing, not a special situation.
